session.question: What is SG in this review?
session.answer:
SG in this review refers to the smart grid, i.e., the long-developed energy framework for efficient, reliable, and sustainable power system operation. The paper specifically discusses the development of data-driven next-generation smart grid (NGSG) technology and emerging data-driven techniques in smart grids. (ahsan2023datadrivennextgenerationsmart chunk 1)

This interpretation is consistent with the related review literature in the context, which also uses SG to denote smart grid in discussions of sustainable smart grid research, stability, security, and smart grid communication/authentication. (geng2023researchprogressanalysis chunk 1, tanveer2023lacpsglightweightauthentication chunk 1)

From Yuqing Geng, Naiguang Zhang, and Renjun Zhu. Research progress analysis of sustainable smart grid based on citespace. Energy Strategy Reviews, 2023. URL: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.esr.2023.101111, doi:10.1016/j.esr.2023.101111.

pqac-3d507713: The abstract states that the review focuses on recycling of “spent graphite (SG) anodes” in lithium-ion batteries. Thus, SG refers to spent graphite, specifically used or exhausted graphite anodes recovered from batteries for recycling and upcycling into regenerated graphite (RG).
From Xue–Qian Li, Chenglong Deng, Mengyao Liu, Jiawei Xiong, Xiaodong Zhang, Qiaoyi Yan, Jiao Lin, Cen Chen, Feng Wu, Yi Zhao, Renjie Chen, and Li Li. Reutilization and upcycling of spent graphite for sustainable lithium-ion batteries: progress and perspectives. eScience, 2025. URL: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.esci.2025.100394, doi:10.1016/j.esci.2025.100394.

pqac-7529eec3: The paper’s abstract states that it examines the impact of intellectual capital dimensions on “sustainable growth (SG)” with the mediating role of sustainable competitive advantage. Thus, SG is the abbreviation used for sustainable growth.
From Yuqiu Lu, Guowei Li, Zhe Luo, Muhammad Anwar, and Yunju Zhang. Does intellectual capital spur sustainable competitive advantage and sustainable growth?: a study of chinese and pakistani firms. SAGE Open, 2021. URL: https://doi.org/10.1177/2158244021996702, doi:10.1177/2158244021996702.

pqac-4e4eaf2f: The excerpt is about a paper titled “LACP-SG: Lightweight Authentication Protocol for Smart Grids.” In the abstract, SG appears repeatedly in the context of “smart grid (SG) systems” and “communication in the SG system.” Thus, SG refers to Smart Grid. The paper discusses secure, lightweight authentication between smart meters and a server in smart grid environments, using hash functions and authenticated encryption to establish a session key and protect communications.
From Muhammad Tanveer and Hisham Alasmary. Lacp-sg: lightweight authentication protocol for smart grids. Sensors (Basel, Switzerland), 2023. URL: https://doi.org/10.3390/s23042309, doi:10.3390/s23042309.
